title: New, Limited-Edition Reese’s Puffs PB+J Cereal is The Nostalgic Flavor Combo Everyone’s Been Waiting For - General Mills
summary: A bold spin on the legendary pairing from Reese's Puffs cereal, just in time for back to school.
body_markdown:
MINNEAPOLIS – *Reese’s Puffs* cereal is bringing **** another iconic flavor combination to the cereal aisle with the launch of new, limited-edition *Reese's Puffs* PB+J cereal. Inspired by the fan-favorite *Reese's* PB+J Cups, *Reese’s Puffs* PB+J cereal blends its signature peanut butter and chocolate flavor with the taste of strawberry jelly for a fun, nostalgic cereal experience.


“Perhaps the only flavor pairing that stands up as well as peanut butter and chocolate is peanut butter and jelly, so we figured it was time to combine all three in one epic bowl of *Reese’s Puffs cereal* ,” said Megan Brooks, Business Unit Director for *Reese’s Puffs* at General Mills. “After seeing fans eat up the *Reese’s* PB+J Cups, we knew that beloved combination deserved a place in the cereal aisle too.”


## *Reese’s Puffs* Flavor Innovation


*Reese’s Puffs* PB&J cereal follows last year’s debut of *Reese’s Puffs* Dark Chocolate cereal, which provided a richer, deeper take on the beloved classic. Now, *Reese’s Puffs* is surprising fans with a nostalgic lunchbox flavor just in time for back-to-school season, perfect ** for early classes, late-night study sessions, hanging with the roommates and everything in between.


And to further elevate that nostalgia, every box of *Reese's Puffs* PB+J cereal also includes exclusive temporary tattoos — a throwback to in-pack surprises that gives fans a playful way to rep their favorite cereal.


## Get *Reese’s Puffs* PB+J Cereal Before It’s Gone


*Reese’s Puffs* PB+J cereal is available now in retailers nationwide, but for a limited-time only — grab a box before they’re gone.


For more, visit[ReesesPuffs.com](https://www.reesespuffs.com/) and[@reesespuffs](https://www.instagram.com/reesespuffs/) on social for the latest product news and updates.
